test_cases_present: partial — the spec describes mandatory and optional features (Tables 2, 3, 4, 15) that map directly to compliance test scenarios; Annex C provides normative FSMs and Annex D provides typical communication examples, but no formal testbench.
derived_compliance_test_categories: START / STOP / Repeated START condition generation + detection (I3C timing per Table 58/59)
Address Header 7-bit + RnW + ACK/NACK handshake
Broadcast Address 7'h7E recognition by all I3C Slaves
Hot-Join Address 7'h02 issuance from Bus Idle Condition
Reserved address compliance per Table 9 (single-bit-error detect 7'h3E/5E/6E/76/7A/7C/7F)
SDR Data Word 8 + T-Bit framing (no ACK on data)
T-Bit odd-parity computation for Master-Write (XOR(Data[7:0],1))
T-Bit end-of-data behavior for Slave-Read (T=1 continue / T=0 end / Master abort via Sr)
Required Broadcast CCC coverage: ENEC, DISEC, ENTAS0, RSTDAA, ENTDAA, SETMWL, SETMRL
Required Direct CCC coverage: ENEC, DISEC, ENTAS0, RSTDAA, SETNEWDA, SETMWL, SETMRL, GETMWL, GETMRL, GETPID, GETBCR, GETDCR, GETSTATUS
Dynamic Address Assignment (ENTDAA): 48-bit Provisional ID arbitration + BCR + DCR + assigned-DA + 1-bit odd parity
Provisional ID Collision Detection and Correction (Section 5.1.4.3)
SETDASA (point-to-point) + SETAASA (set-all-from-static)
In-Band Interrupt: Bus Available Condition → SDA-LOW → arbitrable address → ACK / Mandatory Byte / Repeated START on NACK
Hot-Join: Bus Idle Condition → 7'h02 → ACK + ENTDAA (or NACK / ACK + DISHJ)
Secondary Master Request + GETACCMST handoff (Annex C Figure 61, 62, 44)
Master Clock Stall conditions (Table 11) — 6 stall windows
HDR Exit Pattern detection by every device (including SDR-Only)
Mixed Fast Bus tDIG_H_MIXED ≤ 45 ns enforcement (I2C 50 ns Spike Filter test)
Pure Bus full 12.5 MHz / 12.9 MHz max SDR speed test
Failsafe pad leakage compliance for Hot-Join devices (Section 5.1.5.1 + Table 54)
Error type S0..S6 detection / S0 incorrect-address ignore behavior
Error type M0..M2 escalation behavior
Activity State CCCs (ENTAS0..3) and tCAS adjustment per Table 12
BCR / DCR / LVR / PID register access via GETBCR / GETDCR / GETPID Direct CCCs
